title: Ninu Matrame Ne Nammanaya – John J Telugu Christian Lyrics
translation: I trust in You alone.
You alone are my courage, O Jesus.
Your mighty strength leads me,
And sets right all my situations.
You are the One who shows grace to Your children.
When You command, nothing is impossible.
When You send Your word, nothing fails to happen.
Everything belongs to You, O glorious Lord.
I will sing praises to You.
You are the One who provides for Your children.
When You go before me, who can stand against me?
When You act, who can hinder Your work?
The battle belongs to You, O mighty warrior.
I will move forward with confidence.
You are the One who gives victory to Your children.
When You show mercy, who can condemn?
When You fill me with strength, who can defeat me?
Help comes from You, O my helper.
I will hide myself in You.
You are the One who gives strength to Your children.
intro: Ninu Matrame Ne Nammanaya is the latest Telugu Christian song written, tuned & sung by Bro John J and music composed & produced by Sareen Imman. This song was released on May 5, 2025, through Bro John J YouTube Channel.
